notes: Countywide separately elected Sheriff. The official Sheriff page identifies Eric Fagan and states that voters re-elected him on November 5, 2024; the official sheriff history lists him as serving from 2021 to present.
Countywide separately elected County Clerk. The official County Clerk page identifies Honorable Laura Richard as the current officeholder.
Countywide separately elected District Clerk. The official District Clerk page identifies Honorable Beverley McGrew Walker, and the official biography states that she is serving her second term.

Countywide separately elected Tax Assessor-Collector. The official biography identifies Carmen P. Turner, and the official tax-rate portal independently identifies Carmen Turner for the Fort Bend County Tax Office.

Countywide separately elected County Treasurer. The official Treasurer page identifies Bill Rickert, and the official Treasurer history lists William T. Bill Rickert Jr. as serving from 2019 to present.
